summary: Your need for freedom in love shows up through who you pick. You may be drawn to the unpredictable, the unavailable, or people who keep you on your toes. Or you become the one who won't commit.
body: Your need for freedom in love shows up through who you pick. You may be drawn to the unpredictable, the unavailable, or people who keep you on your toes. Or you become the one who won't commit. The push-pull between wanting a partner and needing your independence plays out in every bond, where closeness and claustrophobia trade places. The work is owning both sides yourself instead of casting someone else as the wild one. You can be devoted and free in the same relationship.
gift: At your best: devoted and independent, free inside connection.
shadow: The trap: casting someone else as the wild one so you don't have to own it.
integration: Let love and values and freedom and disruption cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Good for fresh, original creative and social moves; unreliable for steady commitments.
do: Own both the wanting and the needing-space
Stay when closeness feels like too much
dont: Pick the unavailable to stay free
Make a partner hold the chaos
Read commitment as the end of freedom
